sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: the "Date info" family gains two new sections, "- Year" (exact calendar year) and "- Weekday" (COMPUTED day-of-week, via `Date.prototype.getDay()` — contrast with the unrelated, third-party-scraped "Release events - Weekday"), via new `_dateAtomYear()`/`_dateAtomWeekday()` bucketers alongside the existing `_dateAtomDecade()`/`_dateAtomMonth()`. `_highlightDateAtomMatch()` extended to highlight the matching YYYY substring for Year (same mechanism as Decade) and the whole matching date atom for Weekday (since the weekday name is never literal cell text).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: "Date info" family (see WIP.1) now also applies to `dateTimeParts`-derived pure-date synthetic columns, not just `dateParts`-fed ones — `_dateExprColumnNames()` extended to recognize a `dateTimeParts` entry's own date-only output column. New `Date`/`Start date`/`End date` → `dateTimeParts` wiring on `/election/<n>` ("Date" → "Vote date"/"Vote time") and `/elections` ("Start date"/"End date" → "Election start/end date"/"time"). This also fixes `*/annotations`' existing "Revision date" column, which previously got NO "Date info" sections at all since the gate only recognized `dateParts`.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Unique-values dropdown: the "Editor info" family (Deleted/Recorded name/Membership/Comment), previously scoped only to `*/annotations`' "Editor" column, now also applies to `/elections`' Candidate/Proposer/1st seconder/2nd seconder columns and `/election/<n>`'s Voter column, via a new `EDITOR_INFO_COLUMN_NAMES` Set (was a single fixed-name check).
